for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "780", "observation": "A soft, sustained piano chord is audible, providing a gentle musical backdrop to the spoken words."}, {"id": "795", "observation": "A soft, sustained musical chord is audible beneath the female vocal performance."}, {"id": "810", "observation": "A gentle piano melody plays softly, accompanied by a subtle, continuous background hum."}, {"id": "825", "observation": "A female voice sings over a gentle, melodic piano accompaniment with subtle, sustained string-like textures in the background."}, {"id": "855", "observation": "A female vocalist sings over a pop song featuring a steady drum beat, bass guitar, and electric guitar."}, {"id": "870", "observation": "A female vocalist sings over a gentle piano melody in a slow, melancholic ballad with soft, sustained musical tones."}, {"id": "885", "observation": "A person plays a piano with his right hand."}]
